description: Can you infect the world? Plague Inc. is a unique mix of high strategy and terrifyingly realistic simulation.  Your pathogen has just infected 'Patient Zero'. Now you must bring about the end of human history by evolving a deadly, global Plague whilst adapting against everything humanity can do to defend itself.   Brilliantly executed with innovative gameplay and built from the ground up for touchscreen, Plague Inc. from developer Ndemic Creations evolves the strategy genre and pushes mobile gaming (and you) to new levels. It??s You vs. the world - only the strongest can survive!
